vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Prepare item tags and listings with measured dimensions and visible-condition notes.
requirements.zh: 准备带有实测尺寸及可见状况备注的物品标签和上架信息。

requirements.en: Maintain clear display, review-hold and sold-awaiting-collection statuses.
requirements.zh: 维护清晰的展示、暂留审核及已售待取状态。

requirements.en: Explain listed item details, book collections and refer technical-condition questions appropriately.
requirements.zh: 说明上架物品详情、预订取货，并适当转交技术状况问题。

requirements.en: Support showroom positioning under team-handling plans and maintain useful closing handovers.
requirements.zh: 按团队搬运安排协助展厅摆放，并维护实用的闭店交接。
